SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
SETTINGS.FOOT_NOTE: Changes apply as you make them — there is no Save
SETTINGS.FILE_HINT: Everything above lives in one localStorage entry ({{key}}). Resetting also clears the keys this plugin wrote before there was a settings page.
SETTINGS.RESET_CONFIRM: Reset every dashboard setting to its default?

SECTIONS.GENERAL_SUB: Formats and locale, applied to every view
SECTIONS.DEFAULTS_SUB: What each control shows when the dashboard opens. Remember keeps the last used value; Pin always starts from a fixed one.
SECTIONS.DATA_SUB: Everything here changes what the numbers mean, not just how they look
SECTIONS.APPEARANCE_SUB: Purely visual — nothing here changes a number
SECTIONS.GOALS_SUB: Targets are drawn onto the Dashboard tab — a dashed line across the bar chart, a bar under the Total Time card
SECTIONS.ADVANCED_SUB: Refresh, export and the settings file itself

ROWS.WEEK_START_HINT: Drives “This Week” and the day the weekly bar chart starts on
ROWS.DATE_FORMAT_HINT: Auto follows the host app’s locale
ROWS.TIME_FORMAT_HINT: Decimal hours is what pastes into a timesheet or invoice
ROWS.HIDE_NON_WORKING_HINT: Removes those days from the range entirely, so weekends stop flattening the chart
ROWS.SORT_HINT: Where the table starts before you click a column header
ROWS.INCLUDE_ARCHIVED_HINT: Turning this off is the single biggest speed-up on a vault with a long archive
ROWS.EXCLUDED_PROJECTS_HINT: Dropped from every stat, chart and table
ROWS.EXCLUDED_TAGS_HINT: A task carrying any excluded tag is dropped
ROWS.RUNNING_TIMER_HINT: Adds the in-progress session to today’s total
ROWS.SUBTASK_ROWS: List subtasks as their own rows
ROWS.SUBTASK_ROWS_HINT: Detailed List only — a parent’s time already rolls up its subtasks, so totals never change
ROWS.MIN_ENTRY_HINT: Keeps 30-second scraps out of the totals and the table
ROWS.NO_DUE_DATE_HINT: Replaces the fixed footnote under the Overdue card
ROWS.HIDE_EMPTY_HINT: Trims the By Project / Tag dropdown to entities with data in range
ROWS.THEME_HINT: Follow app mirrors the host’s own light/dark class
ROWS.PALETTE_HINT: Used by the pie chart and its legend
ROWS.BAR_GROUPING_HINT: Auto keeps the existing rules: daily under a month, weekly for a month, monthly beyond
ROWS.PIE_SLICES_HINT: Rolls everything past the top N into one “Other” slice
ROWS.STAT_CARDS_HINT: Unchecked cards are hidden and the row re-flows
ROWS.DAILY_TIME_GOAL_HINT: Dashed line on the bar chart, and the Total Time card’s bar when a single day is in view
ROWS.WEEKLY_TIME_GOAL_HINT: Progress bar under the Total Time card when a week-length period is in view
ROWS.DAILY_TASK_GOAL_HINT: Dashed line on the bar chart when it shows Tasks completed
ROWS.AUTO_REFRESH_HINT: The dashboard also refreshes whenever the host app reports a change, so Off is not the same as stale
ROWS.DEBUG_LOGGING_HINT: Off by default: one log line per task, per refresh
